headline: Central Fronts See Fresh Base-Line Shifts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the front lines moving again, chiefly in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County. Weathered Expanse recorded nine strategic-base events in the past two hours and 90 in 24 hours; its present count is one Warden, five Colonial, and three neutral bases, differing from the previous edition’s one Warden, two Colonial, and six neutral. Mooring County likewise remains in motion, with six events in two hours and 48 across the day; it now lists ten Warden and two Colonial bases, while the earlier report showed all twelve Warden-held. Callahan’s Passage has not gone quiet after all, posting two recent events and 15 over 24 hours, with nine Warden and one Colonial base. Nevish Line retains a contested ledger of six Warden and two Colonial bases, though its 20 daily events have not included a fresh two-hour change. Marban Hollow is seeing heavy casualty activity but no recorded base event in the latest day. Kuura Strand’s earlier turbulence also persists in the record, though its recent windows are quiet. The sharpest immediate pressure remains on Weathered Expanse and Mooring County.
